description_en: Upgrades or downgrades the specifications of a Data Lakehouse Edition cluster
description_zh: 对湖仓版集群进行升降配
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-db-cluster --db-cluster-id amv-bp1r053byu48p0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBCluster

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html operation to query the ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster
parameters.help_zh:
湖仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html接口查看湖仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html operation to query the region ID of the specified Data Lakehouse Edition cluster
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html接口查看指定湖仓版集群的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The reserved storage resources. Valid values: 0 ACUs to 2064 ACUs. Step: 24. One ACU is approximately equal to 1 core and 4 GB of memory.
Include the unit when you specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
存储预留资源。取值范围：0ACU～2064ACU，步长：24。1 ACU约等于1核4 GB。
参数填写时，需要带单位
parameters.name: storage_resource

parameters.help_en:
The reserved compute resources. Valid values: 0 ACUs to 4096 ACUs. Step: 16. One ACU is approximately equal to 1 core and 4 GB of memory.
Include the unit when you specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
计算预留资源。取值范围：0ACU～4096ACU，步长：16。1 ACU约等于1核4 GB。
参数填写时，需要带单位
parameters.name: compute_resource

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether all reserved compute resources are allocated to the default resource group (user_default). Valid values:
true: Yes. This is the default value.
false: No
parameters.help_zh:
计算预留资源是否全部分配给默认资源组（user_default），取值说明：
true（默认值）：是
false：否
parameters.name: enable_default_resource_pool

parameters.help_en:
The product edition. Valid values:
IntegrationForm: Integrated Edition.
LegacyForm: Data Lakehouse Edition
parameters.help_zh:
产品形态。取值为：
IntegrationForm：融合形态。
LegacyForm：湖仓版
parameters.name: product_form

parameters.help_en:
The node specifications for reserved storage resources. Valid values: 8 ACUs, 12 ACUs, and 16 ACUs.
Include the unit when you specify this parameter. This parameter is required only when ProductForm is set to IntegrationForm
parameters.help_zh:
存储预留资源节点规格，支持8ACU，12ACU，16ACU
参数填写时，需要带单位，仅ProductForm取值为IntegrationForm时，填写该参数
parameters.name: reserved_node_size

parameters.help_en:
The number of reserved nodes. 
For Enterprise Edition, the default value is 3 and the step is 3.
For Basic Edition, the default value is 1.
This parameter is required only when ProductForm is set to IntegrationForm
parameters.help_zh:
预留节点数。 
企业版默认为3节点，步长为3。
基础版默认为1节点。
仅ProductForm取值为IntegrationForm时，填写该参数
parameters.name: reserved_node_count

parameters.help_en: The node specifications for the AI node
parameters.name: ai_node_spec

DBClusterId.description_en: The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster
